idiom.note: agent_t subclasses on their DIRECT mboxes (faster than the samples' shared mbox), messages derived from so_5::message_t, active_obj dispatcher for cores>=2 and one_thread below it

caveats: cores>=2 uses the active_obj dispatcher (one work thread per agent); cores=1 uses one_thread. The work threads are pinned one per CPU from the harness's set through a custom so_5::disp::abstract_work_thread_factory_t, so SObjectizer gets the same placement qb and CAF get rather than being the one framework left floating
wait=1 maps to combined_lock_factory with a 10 s spin budget (never reached inside a hop); wait=0 maps to simple_lock_factory (mutex + condition variable)

Messages derive from so_5::message_t and travel on each agent's DIRECT mbox. Both of SObjectizer's shipped ping-pong samples use a shared mbox instead, which is simpler and slower; the faster idiom is used here on purpose
